description: This file defines the RecursiveValidator class for validating typed data objects within Drupal, extending Symfony's Validator interface with custom recursive validation logic.

classes.name: RecursiveValidator
classes.description: A validator class for recursively validating Drupal typed data objects, implementing Symfony's ValidatorInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the validator with context factory, validator factory, and typed data manager.

methods.name: startContext
methods.description: Starts a new validation context for a given root object.

methods.name: inContext
methods.description: Creates a new validator context based on an existing execution context.

methods.name: getMetadataFor
methods.description: Returns metadata for a typed data object, throws exception if input is not a typed data object.

methods.name: hasMetadataFor
methods.description: Checks if metadata exists for a given value, returns true if value is a typed data object.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value against constraints, returning list of violations.

methods.name: validateProperty
methods.description: Validates a specific property of an object.

methods.name: validatePropertyValue
methods.description: Validates a property value of an object or class, throws exception if input is not an object.
